resources.string: Uses NestedScrollMode.FixedContent; the content stays fixed while the Header or Footer slides
Uses NestedScrollMode.Translate; the Header or Footer slides together with the content
Classic refresh with auto load more
Uses NestedScrollMode.Translate; the Header or Footer slides together with the content, and load-more can be triggered automatically
Uses NestedScrollMode.FixedFront; both the Header/Footer and the content stay fixed, only the state changes
Uses NestedScrollMode.FixedBehind; the Header/Footer stays fixed and only the content slides
Randomly switches scroll modes; the linkage between Header/Footer and the content is determined by [NestedScrollMode]
After passing the refresh threshold, keep pulling down to enter the Header secondary content (like a second floor); keep pulling up to enter the Footer secondary content (basement)
Pull-to-refresh only; used to compare the effect with UltraSwipeRefresh (may be removed later)
Pull-to-refresh only; used to compare the effect with UltraSwipeRefresh (may be removed later)
UltraSwipeRefresh: an ultimate pull-to-refresh and load-more Compose component; a perfect replacement for the official SwipeRefresh with richer features and stronger extensibility.
[headerIndicator] and [footerIndicator] are fully customizable, and Header/Footer styles can be combined with scroll modes freely.
